schema.axes: orientation of the 8x8x30 nm voxel grid, the fitted midline and the evidence
schema.tectum: [{seg_id, side, pos, lore_ids, layer, cell_type}] one entry per agglomeration segment; pos = soma position (8 nm voxels, mean if a segment holds several tectal somas); side = fish's own side; layer = SPV (periventricular) or neuropil
schema.mauthner: {left|right: {seg_id, lore_id, pos, soma_volume_um3, candidates[], evidence{}}, method}
schema.spn: [{lore_id, seg_id, side, class (turning|forward), name, classifier, prox, in_authors_state, pos, atlas_region, seg_check, neurotransmitter}]
schema.spn_mirror_candidates: [{of_lore_id, name, class, side, lore_id, seg_id, distance_to_mirror_point_um, volume_um3, named_cell_volume_um3, score, pos}] UNCONFIRMED other-side partners
schema.sources: every input with its URL or path

axes.y: fish's right -> fish's left (increasing y = toward the fish's LEFT)
axes.left_side_rule: left if y > midline.a + midline.b * x, else right

midline.formula: y_mid = a + b * x (8 nm voxels)

evidence.left_right: Fish1 authors' LateralLineVisualization state: segments named pre_prop_MONs_left sit at high y, pre_prop_MONs_right at low y (see mon_check)

exclusions.rule: Visual input enters the model only through tectum_drive() into the cells in 'tectum'. No segment in seg_ids may receive any direct sensory or injected current; they are read out (Mauthner, SPNs) or sit between the senses and the readout.
exclusions.also_never: Do not inject visual current into any non-tectal cell (retina, pretectum, hindbrain). If a later model drives retinal afferents instead of tectal somata, that replaces tectum_drive, it is not added on top.

retinotopy.rule: each eye -> contralateral lobe; frontal field -> anterior (low x); rear field -> posterior; upper field -> dorsomedial; lower field -> ventrolateral; position within a lobe by rank (see fishbrain/cells.py lobe_coords)

sources.somas: CAVE fish1_full table somas, materialization v709, cached data/ref/cave_somas_full.parquet
